chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:
"The winds are five, and among them is the barren wind, so we seek refuge in Allah from its evil."

key_terms.الرِّيَاحُ: the winds; natural moving airs mentioned as distinct kinds
key_terms.الْعَقِيمُ: the barren wind; a destructive or non-productive wind
key_terms.بِاللَّهِ: in Allah; the One from whom protection is sought
key_terms.خَمْسَةٌ: five; the number of categories referred to in the statement
key_terms.شَرِّهَا: its evil; the harm or destructive effect of that wind
key_terms.فَنَعُوذُ: so we seek refuge; turning to Allah for protection

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about the different types of winds and the barren wind?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام states that there are five kinds of winds and identifies one of them as the barren wind. The report highlights awareness of divine signs in creation and teaches seeking refuge in Allah from harmful natural forces.
